title: Fix three bugs in a Rust integer calculator
description: Three calculator operations have bugs: power uses addition instead of multiplication, abs_diff returns signed difference, and gcd always returns the first argument.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. `power`: change `fold(0, |acc, _| acc + base)` to `fold(1, |acc, _| acc * base)`
2. `abs_diff`: change `a - b` to `(a - b).abs()`
3. `gcd`: change `b = a` to `b = a % b` in the while loop
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
